description:
Descriptive technical read for a crypto asset on closed 15m/1h/4h/1d candles: bias (strong bearish ... strong bullish), trend (up/down/mixed) and regime (trending/ranging) from RSI, MACD, EMA 20/50/200, Bollinger and ADX. Free preview tier. The paid x402 routes add every indicator value and the bias components (/v1/lite), VaR/CVaR, drawdowns and ATR position sizing (/v1/risk) and rule backtests (/v1/backtest). Read-only analytics; not financial advice.

[TASignal via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as TASignal's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.005 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.
